title: Visual Communications System Renewal Effort Acknowledgements
slide_intent: Show who contributed to each part of identity development. Grouping credits by responsibility helps readers understand how the system came together.
strategic_value: CSAIL can recognize the people behind its mission, mark and communications system and distinguish committee work from supporting contributions.
demonstration: A narrow heading at left introduces a single stacked credits column. Separate headings identify committees for mission and tagline, logotype, visual system and implementation, followed by supporting organizations.
practical_value: Use functional groups when attributing a shared identity project so readers can locate a contribution without parsing one undifferentiated list.
